portuguese coffee | Delta Cafés — The coffee of your life
probe.text_sample: The first portuguese coffee | Delta Cafés — The coffee of your life The house of coffee Delta Cafés Coffee Culture Products Business Solutions Sustainability Journal 2026 © Delta Cafés pt Português English Menu Close Delta Cafés Coffee Culture Products Business Solutions Sustainability Journal D de Delta Quiz Delta Cafés Our History About Delta The Azores coffee Coffee Culture Coffee Cycle Barista Academy Coffee Science Centre SOM: OFF 2026 © Delta Cafés The First Portuguese Coffee Film (11:50) More than coffee, a story of passion and perseverance. Although coffee has been part of European culture for centuries, growing it here was long considered impossible. Climate and geography made sustainable coffee cultivation seem out of reach. In the Azores, coffee cultivation began in the 19th century, when a Brazilian military officer introduced the first coffee plants to São Miguel. Production eventually disappeared, leaving only a handful of isolated trees. Today, however, coffee is making a remarkable return, driven by families who believe in its future.
